The model disagreement reflects this transition period where short-term technicals remain supportive but longer-term models are picking up underlying weakness. The 'BULL-DELUDED' CAG reading combined with a pinned vol regime suggests complacency in the market despite building pressure. VIX at 19.13 indicates elevated but not extreme fear, consistent with a market at an inflection point.

analysis.model_trust: Trust the 21d CHAMPION model more - it's designed for regime changes and the disagreement pattern typically resolves in favor of longer timeframes when vol is pinned
